# archestra_team_vault_folder (Resource)

One team's mapping to an existing Vault folder. Requires read-only Vault and the relevant enterprise entitlement. Declare one mapping per team; destroy removes the mapping without changing Vault folders or secrets. Import by team ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_team" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering"
}

# The Vault folder must already exist. This maps the team to it without
# creating, reading, or changing Vault secrets.
resource "archestra_team_vault_folder" "engineering" {
  team_id    = archestra_team.engineering.id
  vault_path = "secret/data/teams/engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `vault_path` (String) Existing Vault folder path.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Mapping creation timestamp.
- `folder_id` (String) Server-generated mapping row ID.
- `id` (String) Team ID identifying the mapping.
- `updated_at` (String) Mapping update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_team_vault_folder.engineering "TEAM_ID"
```
